progress.discovering: Listening for Sony projector announcements for up to {seconds} seconds

user.title: Select a Sony projector
user.description: Projectors broadcasting Sony SDAP announcements appear automatically.

select.title: Select a Sony projector
select.description: Select a discovered projector or enter its address manually.

manual.title: Enter projector address
manual.description: ADCP must be enabled in the projector's network settings.

auth.title: Projector authentication
auth.description: The projector at {host} requires its web administrator password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the projector

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The address belongs to a different projector

user.title: Add custom ADCP sensor
user.description: Read-only queries share your projector's refresh interval and run only while fully on. Enter a command name without arguments or ?. Support and response format are checked at the next scheduled refresh, not when saving. [Custom sensor documentation](https://github.com/tokyotexture/home-assistant-sony-adcp/blob/beta/2.4-custom-sensors/docs/custom-sensors.md)

data_description.command: Lowercase command name, for example aspect. The integration appends ?; commands cannot set values.
data_description.json_field: Leave empty for the whole response. For JSON, use dot-separated keys and zero-based array indexes, for example 0.main.
data_description.unit: Optional display unit such as %. No device class or statistics type is inferred.

reconfigure.title: Edit custom ADCP sensor
reconfigure.description: Saving reloads the projector integration. The sensor keeps its identity and history. [Custom sensor documentation](https://github.com/tokyotexture/home-assistant-sony-adcp/blob/beta/2.4-custom-sensors/docs/custom-sensors.md)

data_description.command: Command name only, without arguments or ?. Support varies by model.
data_description.json_field: Dot-separated keys and zero-based array indexes; empty means the whole response.
data_description.unit: Numeric sensors only. Clear this field when switching to text.

error.invalid_name: Enter a name between 1 and 100 characters
error.invalid_command: Use a lowercase command name only: letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (maximum 64 characters). Do not include spaces, arguments or ?.
error.invalid_json_field: Use dot-separated keys or array indexes (maximum 128 characters), or leave empty
error.invalid_unit: Units require a numeric sensor and must be 30 characters or fewer

abort.too_many_sensors: A projector can have at most 32 custom sensors. Remove one before adding another.

init.title: Projector status refresh
init.description: Choose how often to refresh input, signal, custom sensors, and optional picture settings while the projector is fully on. Normal refresh pauses during fast power-transition monitoring.

data_description.operational_refresh_interval: Changes apply immediately. Disabled stops periodic input, signal, picture-setting and custom-sensor checks, but not SDAP or power monitoring.
data_description.refresh_picture_settings: Refresh supported, enabled picture controls at the same interval: picture mode, sharpness, brightness, contrast, light output, Reality Creation, and video mute. Off keeps input, signal and custom-sensor refresh.
